newsitem.title: USA: NetVantage amends redemption of warrants.
newsitem.headline: NetVantage amends redemption of warrants.

text.p: NetVantage Inc Thursday said it issued an amended notice of redemption formally extending the redemption date for Class A Warrants to 1700 EDT Oct. 24, as previously announced Sept. 20.

Each Class A Warrant entitles the holder to purchase, at an exercise price of $6.21 per share, 1.05 shares of Class A Common stock and a Class B Warrant. The resulting per warrant exercise price for 1.05 shares of Class A Common stock and a Class B Warrant is $6.5205.

Warrant holders desiring to exercise the Class A Warrants must do so prior to 1700 EDT on Oct. 24. All Class A Warrants not exercised prior to the redemption date will be redeemed by the company for $0.05 each. No fractional shares will be issued.
